events.body:
This is the umbrella for the BLT-Autopatch milestone plan. The Week 1 milestone (the original issue) is described first; the later milestones are tracked in the checklist below, each linking back to its GitLab issue (kept read-only in the archived group) for the full description.

## Week 1: Worker Scaffold - Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Queues Setup

**Milestone:** Week 1

Initialize the Cloudflare Python Worker project for BLT-Autopatch.

**Deliverables:**

* Initialize Cloudflare Python Worker project with Wrangler
* Set up `wrangler.toml` with D1, Queues, Cron bindings
* Create D1 schema for `cvd_cases`, `patch_audit_log`, `repository_context` tables
* Configure Cloudflare Queues for inter-worker communication
* Set up Cloudflare Cron Triggers skeleton
* Add logging and error handling infrastructure
* Unit tests for D1 schema operations

## Later milestones

- [ ] Ingestion Adapters - BLT Issues + NetGuardian + NVD (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-autopatch#2)
- [ ] Triage Engine — Severity/Confidence Routing + Context Extractor (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-autopatch#3)
- [ ] LLM Patch Generation Pipeline (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-autopatch#4)
- [ ] Static Analysis Validator — ruff + eslint + semgrep (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-autopatch#5)
- [ ] Diff Sanity Checks + CONTRIBUTING.md Parser (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-autopatch#6)
- [ ] Human Review Queue UI + 8 CWE Strategy Templates (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-autopatch#7)
- [ ] CVD State Machine + Embargo Enforcement (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-autopatch#8)
- [ ] Notification Engine + Advisory Generator (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-autopatch#9)
- [ ] CVD Dashboard + End-to-End Validation (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-autopatch#10)
- [ ] GitHub App + PR Submission + Fork Manager (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-autopatch#11)
- [ ] BACON Reward Integration (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-autopatch#12)
- [ ] BLT-MCP Integration + Release (was gitlab owasp-blt/blt-autopatch#13)

---

Moved from https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-autopatch/-/issues/1 (opened by @sidd786b on 2026-06-18).

**Discussion summary**

- This issue is now the umbrella for the BLT-Autopatch GSoC milestone plan (GitLab blt-autopatch#1 to blt-autopatch#13); the milestone issues blt-autopatch#2 to blt-autopatch#13 were closed in favour of the checklist above. As of the move, `blt-autopatch` is only a landing page; no Worker code has landed, and the one foundation MR (blt-autopatch!2) is being closed because it would break the live site.
events.title: blt-autopatch: Milestone plan umbrella: Worker scaffold through BLT-MCP integration and release
